contract: A placement starts at leader epoch 0. An in-ISR election bumps the epoch and keeps the ISR.
Electing a replica outside the ISR is INELIGIBLE_REPLICA unless unclean is set. Unclean election shrinks the ISR to that leader and bumps the epoch.
Reassignment cannot remove the leader. The ISR shrinks to the replicas that remain.
A stale controller epoch cannot change placement. Restart replays the controller epoch, leader, ISR, and leader epoch.
limits: This is not the AlterPartition or AlterPartitionReassignments RPC and it does not move partition bytes.
Follower fetch, high watermarks, and min ISR acknowledgments stay on KL11-18 and KL11-19.
The journal format is the local PLPASN01 record, not an Apache metadata log.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
